title: 16S sequencing of samples from Partial Nitritation and Anammox (PNA) reactors for complex microbial diversity analysis
description: This study aimed to characterize the microbial diversity and community composition of samples collected from partial nitritation and anammox (PNA) reactors using 16S rRNA gene amplicon sequencing. The analysis focused on identifying key microbial groups involved in nitrogen transformation, particularly anaerobic ammonium-oxidizing bacteria and aerobic ammonia-oxidizing bacteria, as well as other microorganisms potentially associated with reactor performance and stability. The generated dataset contributes to a better understanding of the complex microbial interactions occurring in PNA systems and may support the optimization, monitoring, and application of energy-efficient biological nitrogen removal processes for nitrogen-rich wastewater treatment.
